trigger: async/concurrency + attacker-controlled terminal input driving a file-open path

doubts.claim_under_doubt: A plain click on a file link only opens the Viewer
doubts.disproof_attempt: openFromTerminal bumps viewerRequest.nonce; TaskDetailThreePane reacts by toggling the saved right-card collapse, leaving focus mode; on phone a focus tap landing on a path switches away from the terminal.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Make it temporary, skip focus clicks, or record it as an accepted leftover risk for the live try.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: A path with a space is never linked as a whole, nor its tail
doubts.disproof_attempt: Head test runs on the raw token before LEAD/ASSIGN stripping: quoted, parenthesised and --flag= heads bypass it; relative heads (./My Docs/a.ts) leak the tail.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Run the head test on the stripped token; add tests; list relative-head limitation.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: A probe result can never act after its terminal is gone
File links behave correctly inside Claude's TUI (mouse tracking on)
doubts.disproof_attempt: E2E only prints from a plain shell.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Spike/E2E with mouse tracking enabled; record the result.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: The tokenizer is bounded on adversarial long lines
doubts.disproof_attempt: Trailing-strip loop is quadratic on a 1024-char run of ')'.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Run TSC_SUFFIX only if the token contains '('.

summary: 2 medium, 3 low. No security problem found; provider never opens a window, schemes rejected, server decides access, pty/replay/resize untouched.
